build_MarkerRelPosSensor: build a Habitat sensor to track the relative position of a marker to the robot end-effector
build_ArtJointSensor: build a Habitat sensor to get the joint position and velocity of an articulated object
build_ArtJointSensorNoVel: build a Habitat sensor to get only the joint position of an articulated object without velocity
build_ArtObjReward: build a Habitat reward measure for articulated object manipulation tasks with grasp and distance rewards
build_EndEffectorDistToMarker: build a Habitat measure to compute the end-effector distance to a target marker on an articulated object
